description: KINDELORA Affirmation Library. Existing published affirmation inventory. Messages catalogue is separate.

items.title: One breath at a time
items.affirmation: I do not have to carry the whole day at once. One breath. One step. That is enough for now.

items.title: Worthy, just as I am
items.affirmation: I am worthy of kindness even on the days I feel unfinished. I do not have to earn it.

items.title: Tomorrow holds possibility
items.affirmation: A hard day is not the whole story. There is still room for something beautiful.
